newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly traded on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly traded on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly traded Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
Four barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Four barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of September 7 and 14, traded at 165 percent of tariff.
- One barge, Mount Vernon, Ind., Ohio River, this week, bid 120 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, next week, bid 140 percent, no comparison, offer 150 percent, no comparison.
